Description
The University of Otago (Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka), est in 1869 as New Zealand's first university, continues to uphold it's strong international presence and academic excellence. As of 2024, the university hosted approx 3,000 international students from over 100 countries, reflecting its commitment to global engagement. It's diverse academic staff, with over half originating from overseas, contributes to a rich and varied educational environment. The main campus is located in Dunedin fostering a unique and vibrant student community.
